title: Quick check: Class Components: Understanding Legacy React

questions.prompt: Which statement best describes the purpose of “Class Components: Understanding Legacy React”?
options: The concept removes the need to consider error states or accessibility.
The browser will infer all application behavior even if inputs and state are contradictory.
The concept allows application code to mutate React-managed DOM and state directly.
Class component structure should use state setters and immutable next values so React can update the UI predictably.
questions.answer_key: Class component structure should use state setters and immutable next values so React can update the UI predictably.
questions.explanation: The correct choice is grounded in Class Components: Understanding Legacy React: Class component structure should use state setters and immutable next values so React can update the UI predictably.

questions.prompt: Which practice is most reliable when applying Class component structure?
options: Store duplicate copies of every value so each component can change it independently.
Optimize by adding every available Hook without measuring the result.
Use functional updates when the new value depends on previous state, and do not mutate objects or arrays.
Skip validation because a successful render proves that the application is correct.
questions.answer_key: Use functional updates when the new value depends on previous state, and do not mutate objects or arrays.
questions.explanation: The correct choice is grounded in Class Components: Understanding Legacy React: Use functional updates when the new value depends on previous state, and do not mutate objects or arrays.
